title: Untitled (Buckeye Collage)
description: Dense mixed-media collage layered with silver foil, compact discs, fabric lettering reading 'BUCKEYES,' and red ribbon stripes across two horizontal registers. Yellow pennant shapes, a turbine graphic, warplane silhouettes, and an american football fragment occupy the fragmented picture plane.
composition: two horizontal registers of layered fragments
keywords: Ohio State Buckeyes sports memorabilia collage
